description: Reference deploy profile — single-operator Google Workspace (OIDC) login: an auth-only standup with no outbound population. Google OIDC is the login path; the pinned operator becomes tap_admin on first verified login. The example.com values below are RFC 2606 placeholders — replace them with your own Workspace domain and operator address before booting.

auth.description: Single-operator auth: one google_oidc provider restricted to a Google Workspace domain and pinned to a single operator address, who is the initial admin. Local password login is left enabled as a recovery floor so a misconfigured OIDC path cannot lock the operator out; disable it once the Google path is confirmed.

providers.description: Google Workspace OIDC. allowed_domains enforces the returned hd claim; allowed_emails pins login to the named operator even though the whole domain is otherwise eligible. NOTE: the provider id doubles as the secret key — client credentials resolve from the auth:<id> secret, so renaming this id means renaming the secret alongside it.
